settlement.title: {era} Results
settlement.liquidated: All holdings were automatically sold at the current price.
settlement.formula: Returns are time-weighted. Money added mid-era (deposits) is not counted as profit; the era is split at each deposit and the segment returns are multiplied.
settlement.versionChange: The game was updated, so this era was settled at the prices from your last save. The new version applies from the next era.
settlement.pendingWork: {coins} coins of pending work income will be paid after {dolls} more items. It carries over to the next era.

report.title: Market Report
report.firstNotice: Market Report figures are what actually moved inside the game. They are not real market data or investment advice.
report.tentativeNote: This was a tentative report, so the effect was small. The outcome report may change things a lot.

tutorial.title: New here?
tutorial.notice1: News arrives without warning. Within an era, news items have no time order or connection, and even major historical events may not appear in this round.
tutorial.notice2: Only a 'tentative report' and its 'outcome report' about the same event are connected.
tutorial.notice3: Most of a news story's effect hits the price the moment it is announced, and the rest a few seconds later, so studying ahead works better than buying after you read it.
tutorial.notice4: The reaction rates on screen are fictional in-game numbers. They are not the real market or investment advice.
tutorial.stepWaiting: News is coming soon. Please wait a moment.
tutorial.stepReading: News is out! Time stops during the tutorial. Try buying a related stock.
tutorial.stepReaction: Most of the move hits the price the moment the news appears, and the rest 5 seconds later. Then prices keep swinging for 10 more seconds.
tutorial.stepReport: Two minutes later a Market Report appears right under the news. Check which stocks moved and why.
tutorial.done: Tutorial complete! In the main game, time keeps running when news breaks.
tutorial.story1: Kim Yeokjeon, 28, jumped into stocks on gut feeling and lost every coin saved up.
tutorial.story2: All that is left: a moldy rented room, unpaid bills, cup noodles, and one loyal puppy.
tutorial.story3: This time Yeokjeon will study instead of guessing. The 10,000 coins earned gluing eyes on dolls every night are the last chance.
tutorial.story4: The goal: turn life around. Read the news, invest, and turn this shabby room into a great one.
tutorial.how1: One era lasts 1 hour 30 minutes of game time. The time left is shown at the top left (in the account bar on the trading screen). There is no news for the first 3 minutes, so look around and get ready.
tutorial.how2: When news breaks, related prices move at once. Tap a stock, choose [Buy] or [Sell] first, set a quantity or tap [Max], then tap [Buy now]/[Sell now].
tutorial.how3: When time runs out, the era ends. All your shares are sold automatically, and after the settlement you move on to the next era.
tutorial.room1: Attach eyes to dolls in the workshop to earn coins. You get paid every time you finish 100. The job changes with the era (decorating phone cases, then writing blog posts). Each Life Upgrade level adds 1 coin per touch.
tutorial.room2: In the living room, [Life Upgrade] spends cash to improve the room one level at a time (7 levels). The first level costs 2,500 coins and each level costs 1,250 more than the last. You need cash, not stocks.
tutorial.room3: Fictional scenarios inspired by real events. In-game numbers are not investment advice.
tutorial.how4: Coins, life upgrades and work progress carry over to the next era. The eras run 2000s → 2010s → 2020s.
tutorial.how5: News is based on events that really happened in each era. Recall what happened back then and you can guess how a tentative story ends. Use your knowledge of the era when you invest!
tutorial.goal1: Goal: complete all 7 life-upgrade levels before the last era (the 2020s) ends!
tutorial.goal2: The ending depends on your level when the last era ends: levels 0–2 sad, 3–6 neutral, 7 (complete) happy.
tutorial.goal3: Grow your coins by investing, cash out at the right time, and upgrade the room. That's the road to a comeback.

sad.title: Sad Ending · The Same Old Room
sad.body: Time went by, but the room barely changed. Among the moldy walls and the creaky chair, Yeokjeon hugged the dog and muttered, "Next time I'll win by studying."

neutral.title: Neutral Ending · Halfway There
neutral.body: The room now feels like a real home. It isn't the dream room yet, but Yeokjeon can now read the news and decide alone. The comeback is still in progress.

happy.title: Happy Ending · Life Turned Around
happy.body: The moldy rented room became a room anyone would envy. A comeback built on study, not gut feeling. Yeokjeon smiled out the window, the dog by their side.

samsungDark.title: Using Samsung Internet?
samsungDark.body1: If Samsung Internet's dark mode is on, the game may look darker and in different colors. The game can't turn this browser feature off.
samsungDark.body2: To see the original colors, turn off dark mode in Samsung Internet settings, or the option that forces dark mode on web pages.
samsungDark.body3: Opening the game in another browser such as Chrome also shows the original colors.
